# Licences of the starter site library

<!-- Written by `node tools/library.mjs licences`. Do not edit by hand; the tools tests fail when this page and the designs disagree. -->

The library holds 10 designs with 142 photographs and 5 drawn pictures. The pages, texts and settings of every design were written for this project and are part of this repository, which is licensed under the GNU General Public License, version 2 or later, like the theme and the plugin. Photographs are accepted only when Wikimedia Commons records them as CC0 or public domain, drawn pictures were made for this project and are released as their design's statement says, and fonts are accepted only under the SIL Open Font License. All of these can be passed on with GPL software. No design contains code.

The texts, names, prices and figures of all designs are invented sample content. A photograph that shows a recognisable person stands for an invented person and is meant to be replaced; each design's statement names those pictures.
